name: desktop_automation
description: Launch a desktop application, or open/reveal files inside registered source directories. Use launch_app with an executable path and literal args for computer use: the app survives tool completion, unlike child apps started through a managed shell. Verify startup with computer_observe list_windows and capture_window before input. Prefer open_in_nexa for built-in file previews; opening a previewable file externally requires the user's explicit request and external_requested=true. HTTP(S) pages and searches belong to browser_session so the user and Agent share Nexa Browser.

external_requested.description: Set true only when the user explicitly requested opening the file in an external application. Otherwise use open_in_nexa for previewable files.

action.description: Desktop action to perform. All targets must be inside the active registered source scope. launch_app requires an executable file (.exe on Windows).

path.description: Absolute path or source-root relative path for the file or executable. Must resolve inside a registered source directory and the current source scope.

args.description: Literal arguments for launch_app only, passed directly to the executable without shell interpretation. The working directory is the executable's directory.

reason.description: Brief user-facing reason for the desktop file action.
